title: Dark Memories
summary: A man is found bludgeoned to death. The main suspect used to bully JP.
method: The former bully was covering up for his girlfriend, who hit the victim. However, it was someone else who dealt the fatal blow.
motive: Money hidden in a jar of nuts
notes: The actor who played the killer passed away before they finished filming, so the story was rewritten to have him run away before being caught (instead of the usual reveal and confrontation that usually happens).
